title: Credential expiry workaround
statement: After the 24-hour credential expires an offline restart is blocked; reconnect once to refresh before continuing.

title: Recovered entry investigation
statement: An investigation remains open into missing recovered entries after reset; manual exports may omit recently acknowledged entries.

title: Long-run evidence status
statement: No documented 72-hour disconnected cold-start pass is available in the preview evidence set as of this notice.
